input_protocol: All original benchmark fields are retained, including entity/disease anchors, external support annotations, answer options, reference answers and provenance. For mechanistic tracing, the supplied gene anchors include the scored intermediate gene. Reference/evidence fields are evaluation annotations, not retrieved source documents.
reasoning_vs_task_note: The six paper reasoning families group the nine task_type values. Twelve BioASQ factoid/yesno questions join evidence_signal_interpretation; seven BioASQ list questions join hierarchical_evidence_aggregation.
frozen_data_policy: The canonical JSONL is byte-identical to the paper benchmark. Construction uses 73 retained seeds; historical 499-record input is reduced to task counts because it was used only for a construction-summary histogram.
licenses: Source-specific attribution and terms in docs/data.md and data_sources/benchmark/NOTICE.md apply separately from the code license.

construction.grouped_ids: Historical CIViC grouped IDs reused only for exact question/answer matches; stable SHA-256 fallback.
